data.one_liner: Runs Dart code continuously on iOS even when the app is closed.
data.what_it_does: Provides an iOS implementation for the flutter_background_service plugin, allowing background execution of Dart code via BGTaskScheduler. It integrates with the federated plugin system so developers only need to depend on flutter_background_service.
use_when: You need to run periodic or long‑running Dart tasks on iOS without the UI being active
You want a simple way to keep a service alive after the app is terminated
avoid_when: You require cross‑platform background execution and need Android support (use the main flutter_background_service package)
You need fine‑grained control over native background APIs beyond what the plugin offers
strengths: Easy integration via the endorsed federated plugin
Handles iOS background task scheduling and null‑safety
Minimal setup for basic use cases
weaknesses: Limited configurability compared to writing native code yourself
